edition_kicker: THE GLOBAL BRIEF · ONE-DAY WORLD EDITION
deck: COP31 enters overtime in Antalya · BepiColombo captures Mercury orbit · Three missiles downed over Riyadh · EU halts non-OECD plastic exports

stats.label: Climate deal yet at COP31 overtime
EU states halt non-OECD plastic exports
KL Rahul Test ton in Wellington

hero.headline: COP31 runs into Saturday overtime
hero.summary: Talks pass Friday's scheduled close in deadlock after draft 2 omits fossil-fuel phase-out language; a third draft is due Saturday.

hero.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury today
hero.summary: After an eight-year inner-solar-system voyage, ESA and JAXA's twin orbiters execute critical thruster burns to enter orbit.

hero.headline: 3 Houthi missiles downed over Riyadh
hero.summary: Coalition air defenses intercept an early-Saturday ballistic missile salvo over the Saudi capital after a civil defense alert.

cards.headline: Rutte visits Warsaw on airspace breach
cards.summary: NATO chief meets Polish leaders Saturday; Warsaw asks for AWACS and F-35 cover under Eastern Sentry.

cards.headline: EU plastic waste export ban starts
cards.summary: Regulation 2024/1157 halts EU plastic scrap exports to non-OECD countries until at least May 2029.

cards.headline: Kryvyi Rih hit; E5 urges winter truce
cards.summary: Deadly missile-drone strikes hit Zelenskyy's hometown; Europe's E5 powers press Russia for an energy ceasefire.

cards.headline: Japan & India sign live-fire pact
cards.summary: Tokyo 2+2 ministerial opens Indian test ranges to Japan's SDF and condemns arbitrary export curbs.

cards.headline: CA subpoenas Nvidia; 879k China chips
cards.summary: AG Bonta probes China chip ties as a US House panel details ~879,000 licensed advanced AI chips.

cards.headline: Sudan & Ethiopia close consulates
cards.summary: Mutual expulsions shut Assosa and Gedaref missions amid escalating cross-border conflict charges.

cards.headline: KL Rahul hits historic 136 in NZ
cards.summary: First Indian opener with Test centuries in all four SENA nations as India take Day 3 lead.

cards.headline: 54 nations open CAF Assembly
cards.summary: African football leaders and FIFA chief Infantino gather in Abuja for CAF's 48th General Assembly.
